npc: ^Calypso: Thanks a lot for helping out again!
^Calypso: This island wouldn't be this comfortable and fun to be in if it wasn't for you!
^Luna: Say, Calypso... do you ever get sick of this island?
^Calypso: Well, that's a funny question. Why'd you ask?
^Luna: No particular reason... but doesn't it ever feel suffocating to be trapped on an island like this?
^Calypso: Hmm... Since I've been here for a few millennia, I guess this island has just become home.
^Calypso: Though, the thought of seeing new places and exploring the world does sound quite fun...
^Calypso: But with you here now, it's like the outside world has come to me.
^Calypso: With all the stories you tell me, it already feels like I'm exploring the world - your world!
^Luna: Well, thanks... but there really isn't that much to explore in my world.
^Calypso: But I'm always more than happy when you do share your world with me!
^Luna: Well... my parents recently sent me a camera...
^Luna: No, no! It's a machine... um... it captures memories.
^Calypso: I see... a blessing from the Mother of Muses.
^Calypso: We shouldn't disrespect her. Go capture some memories, Luna.
